dispositions.rationale: False positive at PR247 revision aa16285ff988dc3a8f0160c2e66ca43de8fe7157. tests/context_menu.cpp:794 installs new wxLogStderr through wxLog::SetActiveTarget; the reported primary line795 follows that registration. In pinned wxWidgets3.3.3 src/common/log.cpp:531-542 SetActiveTarget stores the supplied logger in wxLog::ms_pLogger and returns only the previous target. src/common/init.cpp:411-416 clears the initialization target before the application's first-statement OnInit registration. wxEntryReal's wxInitializer cleanup scope reaches wxEntryCleanup even on failed initialization; wxAppBase::CleanUp in src/common/appcmn.cpp:148-164 deletes the active target with delete wxLog::SetActiveTarget(nullptr). Normal/caught test callbacks call frame->Destroy and ExitMainLoop. This is retained framework ownership, not a lost allocation. The intentional launch-child std::exit path terminates that child process and is separately reclaimed by the OS; it cannot strand a live parent allocation. Source ownership and shutdown excerpts are retained in final-review/sonar-lifetimes/source-evidence.json; no ownership-disguising code/suppression/gate change.

False positive at PR247 revision aa16285ff988dc3a8f0160c2e66ca43de8fe7157. tests/observer_acknowledgement.cpp:33 passes new wxLogStderr to wxLog::SetActiveTarget immediately before reported line34. wxWidgets3.3.3 log.cpp:531-542 retains it in wxLog::ms_pLogger; the initializer logger was cleared before OnInit (init.cpp:411-416). Final wxEntryCleanup calls wxAppBase::CleanUp, which deletes the active target (appcmn.cpp:164). ObserverApp's success and caught failure paths also call Finish, which resets ProcessObserver before frame->Destroy/ExitMainLoop; ProcessObserver destruction stops its timer and unbinds the frame handler. Deferred top-level windows are deleted during pending-object/final top-level cleanup. The registered logger and native frame remain framework-owned. Exact pinned source excerpts are retained in final-review/sonar-lifetimes/source-evidence.json; no independent owner is missing.

False positive at PR247 revision aa16285ff988dc3a8f0160c2e66ca43de8fe7157. tests/shell_appearance.cpp:146 installs new wxLogStderr via wxLog::SetActiveTarget before reported line147. Pinned wxWidgets3.3.3 SetActiveTarget stores this pointer in ms_pLogger (src/common/log.cpp:531-542); wxAppBase::CleanUp deletes the active logger with delete wxLog::SetActiveTarget(nullptr) (appcmn.cpp:164). The initialization target is cleared before OnInit, and wxEntryReal retains its wxInitializer cleanup scope through application initialization/run failure. The executable is fixed 'git', command fixed 'show', and every revision/blob argument is the pinned 89b8b36e0ee2c23f73be922315f17261ccfbbe1a:res/Toolbar{16,24,32,40,48}.bmp. -C consumes its following value as a directory, so a value beginning with an option cannot add a Git option; installed Git 2.56.1 test `git -C --version show <fixed-blob>` fails 'cannot change to --version' rather than processing --version. Whitespace and shell syntax are not split or evaluated by this argv call. No untrusted document data reaches the command. Constraining this intentional local directory input to ASCII would break valid source paths without closing an injection boundary. Source: https://github.com/1298345095/wxnotepad/blob/aa16285ff988dc3a8f0160c2e66ca43de8fe7157/tools/prepare_toolbar_art.py#L13-L19

False positive at wxnotepad aa16285ff988dc3a8f0160c2e66ca43de8fe7157 tests/document_tools.cpp:95. The RHS GTK_IS_MESSAGE_DIALOG(widget) is a GTK runtime type predicate after the intentional !gtk_widget_get_visible(widget) short circuit. It does not respond to a dialog, select a file, increment test counters, or perform another test action that must always run. The installed GTK macro expands to G_TYPE_CHECK_INSTANCE_TYPE; GLib gtype.h:2683-2692 uses a GNU statement expression assigning only its local _inst/_t/_r temporaries. The slower g_type_check_instance_is_a path (pinned gtype.c:3891-3910) checks the instance/class/type graph and returns its boolean result. A type getter can lazily register its framework type, but no required fixture mutation is lost for a hidden widget. The macro-local assignments trigger this diagnostic; moving/caching the predicate just to hide it would not improve the guard. Actual installed headers, pinned source excerpts and the original predicate are retained in final-review/sonar-documents-ui/dispositions.md. All assertions and short-circuit behavior remain intact.
